company.name: Hootsuite
company.shortDescription: Hootsuite is a platform for managing social media presence and analyzing audience engagement.
company.description: Hootsuite offers tools to schedule posts, monitor brand mentions, and track audience sentiment across numerous social networks and review websites. Its services include real-time alerts and predictive monitoring to manage brand reputation and identify potential crises. The platform facilitates the coordination of social media workflows and provides data analytics to measure the financial impact of digital campaigns. Additionally, the company offers a solution for employee advocacy to extend the reach of organizational content.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $50,000,000, or 16.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $16,297,965 to $750,000,000, a 46.02x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 23 (+10 over 90 days) and market heat at 33 (+2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
